_comment: Mountain packages: one range in more detail than its regions carry – 2 m
contours, rocks and a height model from DMR 5.0 at 1 m, roads, paths, water,
points and aerial photos. Published under `mountains.ranges` in `maps.json`, a
category of its own, built by “Map · Build mountain package”. A range crosses
borders: its OSM layers come from every extract it names, and its height model
is DMR 5.0 where Slovakia has it and Sonny's 20 m model beyond.
country    key in `regions.json` whose data it is mostly made of
area       the cut-out in `areas.json` – its name, bbox and DMR 5.0 at 1 m
countries  ISO codes of every country it lies in
osm        osm.fr extracts below `/extracts/`, cut to the bbox and merged
